integrity: The known Edmonds facet system and its published classification are acknowledged. The metric theorem is supported by an explicit proof; historical priority remains provisional. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Canonical edge-coordinate Euclidean metric for complete graphs of order at least four only. No statement about weighted graphs, affine Minkowski centers, or arbitrary base polytopes. Finite verification cannot establish the unrestricted theorem.
title: A six-vertex Euclidean inball transition for complete-graph spanning-tree polytopes
